resources.string: Estimate how a regular SIP investment grows over time, with optional step-up and inflation adjustment.
Estimate how a one-time lumpsum investment grows over time.
Compare how the same money would grow via monthly SIP versus investing it all at once as a lumpsum.
Find out how much you need to invest monthly to reach a specific savings goal.
Find out how long a monthly investment will take to reach a target amount.
Estimate the maturity value of your Public Provident Fund (PPF) account.
Estimate your Employees\' Provident Fund (EPF) corpus at retirement.
Estimate the maturity value of a Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) account for your daughter.
Estimate your National Pension System (NPS) corpus, lump sum, and monthly pension at retirement.
Calculate your monthly loan EMI, and see the impact of an optional prepayment.
Simulate a Systematic Transfer Plan — moving a lumpsum gradually from one fund into another.
Simulate a Systematic Withdrawal Plan — regular withdrawals from an investment corpus.
See how much a cost today will rise to in the future because of inflation.
FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early) means building a large enough corpus that your investments alone can cover your expenses. Estimate the corpus you need and the SIP required to get there.
Estimate the maturity value of a Fixed Deposit (FD), compounded quarterly.
Estimate the maturity value of a Recurring Deposit (RD), where you deposit a fixed amount every month.
See how much smoking costs you over time, and what that money could grow to if invested instead.
See how much drinking costs you over time, and what that money could grow to if invested instead.
Compare your eating-out spend against home cooking, and see what the savings could grow to if invested.
Estimate the gratuity payable to you under the Payment of Gratuity Act, based on your last drawn salary and years of service.

Results are projections based on the assumptions you enter and are not investment advice.
Increase your monthly investment by this percentage every year, to keep pace with rising income. Leave this blank to invest a fixed amount every month instead.
The rate at which prices rise over time. Enter this to also see the result adjusted to today\'s purchasing power, alongside the plain projected value.

The share of your NPS corpus that must go toward buying an annuity (regular pension) at retirement — current PFRDA rules require at least 40%. The rest can be withdrawn as a lump sum. This minimum is set by PFRDA and may change over time — if it no longer matches the current rule, edit it here; we\'ll update the app\'s default soon after any change.

This is the government-notified PPF interest rate at the time this app was built. The rate is revised quarterly by the Ministry of Finance — if it no longer matches the current official rate, edit it here; we\'ll update the app\'s default soon after any change.

This is the government-notified Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana interest rate at the time this app was built. The rate is revised quarterly by the Ministry of Finance — if it no longer matches the current official rate, edit it here; we\'ll update the app\'s default soon after any change.

This is the government-notified EPF interest rate at the time this app was built. The rate is revised annually by EPFO — if it no longer matches the current official rate, edit it here; we\'ll update the app\'s default soon after any change.

Gratuity = (15 × last drawn monthly salary × years of service) ÷ 26, capped at the statutory maximum of ₹20,00,000. Requires a minimum of 5 years of continuous service to be legally payable.
